commands.selectedRunnerSetup: Copy tools/abaplint-tests-all.mjs to tools/live-views-measure.tmp.mjs in each checkout; immediately after const plan = discoverShards(upstream), insert the two statements recorded in measurementMethod.planChange. Remove temporary copies after reports complete.

measurementMethod.runner: Temporary copy of tools/abaplint-tests-all.mjs from each checkout; the selected plan and summary denominator/provenance are changed. The original Node build/oracle, closure materializer, compiler/runtime fixtures, ownership reconciliation, reports, and genuine-FAIL gate remain intact. No upstream or emitted Go overlays.
measurementMethod.discardedFeatureAttempts: An initial run preceded the nested-element correction; a second failed Go compilation because array.length handling incorrectly reached set.size. Both are excluded. A third run exposed five previously passing ordinary split-array guards receiving a proxy-only absence refusal. It is discarded after narrowing that check to live storage; the final run uses e7c7ee5 and the composed native/live oracle passes.
measurementMethod.baseline: Immutable git archive of 26bcfb6. Discarded an initial attempt that overlapped edits with compiler build.
measurementMethod.default: Both compilers use exactly the same output path; preserve baseline tree before regenerating. Raw bytes compared without normalization.
measurementMethod.aggregation: The stock all-suite summary intentionally rejects a selected denominator. Re-run a temporary copy with 11060 replaced by the independent selected Node active total 3431, and immutable checkout SHAs supplied for archive provenance. Sort the selected manifest file list before the partition comparison. All partition, title-multiset, count and FAIL checks remain intact; raw reports remain unmodified.
measurementMethod.stockSummaryOutcome: The stock summary rejects the selected file partition/whole-suite denominator; both raw shard runs completed without infrastructure failures or FAIL records. The separate selected aggregators returned 0 and reconciled the independent Node title multiset and counts.

limitations: Native structural objects lose omitted/present-undefined and key insertion metadata in their existing constructors; enumeration refuses explicitly rather than inventing keys. The object-literal exclusion was retained.

ABAP parsed/plain dynamic-element arrays cannot alias native typed tables; runtime view refusals are independently executed. ABAP own-key enumeration refuses explicitly. General json.stringifySubset retains its existing explicit emission refusal.
Go representation conversions for unsupported prototype-bearing elements, unrepresentable elements/absence, and reference repacking refuse explicitly.
